The '''Dornean Braha'ket Fleetworks Conglomerate''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufacturer based on the<ref name="Databank" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="GSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Third Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> [[Dornea/Legends|Dornea]]<ref name="Databank" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The conglomerate constructed a number of ship classes for the independent [[Dornean Navy]], which had been waging its own [[Dornea's war against the Empire|private war]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Databank" />

Among the ships produced by the conglomerate for the Dornean Navy were the anti-[[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Braha'tok-class gunship/Legends|''Braha'tok''-class gunships]], designed specifically for [[Space warfare/Legends|space warfare]] and equipped with eight double [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]] and eight [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] launchers. Two of the [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="Databank" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Dornean Braha'ket Fleetworks Conglomerate was mentioned in the ''Braha'tok''-class gunship's [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry on [[StarWars.com]], which was written by user [[Ello137]]<ref name="Databank" /> and became a winning entry for ''[[What's The Story?]]'', a contest on the website's [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature, on [[August 31]], [[2006]].<ref name="Round 6">{{SWArchive|url=databank/updates/news20060831.html|text=What's the Story, Round 6}}</ref>
